summary: First milestone: a Windows desktop UI/frontend for KAIROX, a local-first ransomware-defense concept. This milestone is a mock/demo-data experience only; it performs no monitoring, containment, or security actions.

questions.question: Current UI milestone: a dashboard shell and navigation; demo-data views for intelligence overview, filesystem explorer, telemetry, canary registry, incidents, detection, health, and settings; responsive desktop layout, reusable UI components, and clear demo-only labeling. All charts, statuses, and actions are illustrative; no real monitoring, filesystem access, agent/service integration, containment, or security actions.
